name: Seated Spine Twist
steps: Sit cross-legged on the floor, lengthen your spine and fold your arms loosely across your chest.
Brace your core lightly and rotate your rib cage and shoulders smoothly to one side while keeping both sit bones grounded on the floor.
Pause briefly at the end of your comfortable twist, then rotate smoothly back through center to the opposite side.
Continue alternating smoothly from side to side for the target duration.
tips: Grow tall through the crown of your head before rotating rather than slouching your lower back.
Initiate the twist from your mid-back and obliques instead of whipping your head or arms.
